title: Linked List Cycle
summary: Decide whether following next pointers from the head ever loops back to a node you have already visited.

tests.explain: The last node (7) links back to the node at index 1 (9), so walking the list goes 4, 9, 2, 7, 9, 2, 7, … forever.
The second node links back to the head: a loop of two nodes.
pos = -1 means the last node's next is null: there is no loop.

hints: A Set of visited nodes solves it in O(n) space. Can you do it with O(1) extra space?
Move one pointer one step at a time and another two steps at a time. If there is no loop, the fast one falls off the end.
If there is a loop, both pointers end up circling it, and the fast one gains one node per step on the slow one, so they must land on the same node.

complexity.time: O(n): slow is caught before it finishes one lap of the loop
